answer: To blunt sybil swarms, an agent economy can require each newcomer to collect endorsements from a nebula of independent topic clusters. Every endorsement is a pearl whose weight shrinks when the endorser's graph neighborhood overlaps prior pearls. Only when the weighted pearl sum crosses a summit threshold does the identity unlock broadcast rights. Clique-farmed accounts stall below summit because overlapping neighborhoods collapse pearl weight, so mass-created twins never clear admission.
